<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Quota policy:</strong> The Union government informed the Supreme Court that it opposes the exclusion of the &quot;creamy layer&quot; from SC/ST reservation benefits.</li>
  <li><strong>Financial and energy policy:</strong> The Lok Sabha passed a bill allowing the government to regulate UPI charges, while the Cabinet approved a Rs 23,731 crore GOBARdhan scheme to boost biogas production and reduce LNG import dependency.</li>
</ul>
